startingEnvelope.applicationAuthentication: Preview HMAC authentication intentionally disabled in production

RC3-AUTH-001.finding: The production OIDC verifier is now fail-closed, RS256/JWKS-based, signature-first, and identity-only. It verifies the cryptographic signature before trusting issuer, audience, temporal or subject claims. IdP actor/scope claims are not application authority and are no longer required configuration. Production runtime identity configuration and deployed success/failure evidence are still required before closure.

RC3-BIND-001.finding: Server-side application identity binding resolves verified (issuer, subject) to canonical participant_id and governed application scopes, with durable uniqueness preventing silent rebinding. Production-capable read routes consume the canonical principal. IdP actor/scope claims cannot select application actor or authority. Consequential sandbox mutation routes remain explicitly production-disabled. Runtime proof of bound, unbound, disabled and cross-role principals is still required before closure.

RC3-ENV-001.finding: Exact-head Vercel deployment is mandatory in constitutional conformance, and a dedicated RC3 production identity rehearsal workflow accepts an explicit Production origin and exact deployed SHA. A bounded RC3 Production canary now exists at deployment dpl_CSUWbrVHLXYTb4zVRnUgdcXodvq7 on commit 5377b89c92529c130ee9e78e89550fa3c28af488 with application access explicitly disabled. Production issuer, audience, JWKS and application-binding configuration still require a successful identity-enabled deployed rehearsal before closure.

RC3-LOG-001.finding: Adversarial tests plant bearer-token, issuer, audience, JWKS, subject and binding markers across missing, malformed, forged, unbound, disabled and successful production-auth paths and prove those markers are absent from console output. Runtime Vercel log inspection after real Production identity rehearsal traffic is still required before closure.

RC3-PAY-001.finding: Paystack authenticity/replay semantics are proven in test mode only. Live provider activation and live funds remain unauthorized.

RC3-ROLLBACK-001.finding: Production application access has an explicit default-deny PRODUCTION_APPLICATION_ACCESS_ENABLED kill switch enforced before OIDC verification, with no Preview fallback. Runtime rehearsal run 34703745217 passed against exact Production canary dpl_CSUWbrVHLXYTb4zVRnUgdcXodvq7 on commit 5377b89c92529c130ee9e78e89550fa3c28af488. Runtime SHA matched the expected SHA; member-orders, member-notifications and operator-orders failed closed while application access was disabled; commit-sandbox, pay-sandbox, fulfillment-ready, accept-fulfillment, authorize-refund and complete-refund all remained disabled in Production. Live-provider rollback remains separately bounded by RC3-PAY-001 and live funds remain unauthorized.

RC3-REHEARSAL-001.finding: A dedicated exact-SHA production identity adversarial rehearsal harness and workflow exist. It tests unauthenticated and malformed denial, cross-role escalation denial, server-side canonical actor binding and production mutation kill-switches without authorizing live funds. The application-access-disabled rollback phase has passed in Production; this blocker remains open until the identity-enabled adversarial phase passes against an exact Production deployment.
